# Knative deployment (generated by Cloudhopper)

`chart/` is a Helm chart that runs the application on Knative:

- a Knative `Service` with the application image,
- a `PingSource` per `@ScheduledTrigger` function that calls `POST /schedules/<function>`,
- a `KafkaSource` per `@EventTrigger(source = QUEUE)` function that delivers to `POST /events/<function>`,
  with retries and a `KafkaSink` for the dead-letter topic `<topic>.DLT`.

Build the image from the generated Dockerfile, push it, and install the chart:

```bash
docker build -t <registry>/<app>:<version> -f target/deployment/knative/shared-resources_dockerfile..dockerfile .
docker push <registry>/<app>:<version>
helm upgrade --install <release> target/deployment/knative/chart \
  --set image.repository=<registry>/<app>,image.tag=<version> \
  --set 'kafka.bootstrapServers={my-kafka.kafka.svc:9092}'
```

The cluster needs Knative Serving, Knative Eventing and, for queue functions, the Knative Kafka
source and sink (`eventing-kafka-controller`, `eventing-kafka-source`, `eventing-kafka-sink`).
See `values.yaml` for all settings.
